Your holdings: SOXL is your biggest concern at -70.62%, followed by MUU at -49.58%. Many of your leveraged ETFs are deep in the red. The Nvidia news puts further pressure on your entire chip exposure, amplifying drawdowns due to margin.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Nvidia's board decision and how the broader semiconductor sector reacts. Monitor your stops, especially on leveraged positions.

Bottom line: This is a critical moment for your chip-heavy book; focus on risk management and protecting capital.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far from the current price of 66.03. Consider setting a tighter, more realistic stop or trimming a portion to manage the extreme 70.62% loss.
CRWD: With a 30.94% gain and "TRIM" status, consider taking some profits to reduce overall portfolio risk, especially given the current market uncertainty in tech.
